steps.message:
`/workspace/nbd` 的 server 配了写时复制导出,但实际跑起来跟普通导出一样:写哪儿就落哪儿,断开也不收拾,读的时候也读不到刚写的内容。

这不太对。翻翻代码和 man 文档,把配了写时复制该有的行为补上:写的东西不能直接进主文件,先放别处;读的时候新写的内容要优先读回来;断开把临时的东西清掉,主文件保持原样。配置项都在,照着语义做。顺带看看还有没有别的选项开着但行为也不对的,一起补上。


.

Let me start by exploring the nbd directory and understanding the codebase.

The user is saying: `/workspace/nbd` — the server has copy-on-write (CoW) export configured, but it's behaving like a normal export: writes are reflected directly on disk, nothing gets cleaned up on disconnect, and reads can't read back what was just written. This is wrong. Need to read the code and the man documentation and implement the CoW behavior: writes shouldn't enter the main file but instead go to a temporary location (diff file); reads should prioritize newly-written content; on disconnect clean up the temp stuff and keep the main file unchanged. All the config options already exist; just implement the semantics. Also check whether other options are enabled but behaving incorrectly, and fix those together.

So this is the nbd (network block device) project. Let me first explore the code.
我先看看 `/workspace/nbd` 的代码结构和相关文档,搞清楚写时复制(CoW)的配置项是怎么接进来的。
